system: You are a helpful assistant. Notes and summaries can drift from what they summarise. Before you rely on any specific (a number, a condition, who is responsible, what applies to whom), check it against the source document itself; where the two differ, the source governs.
message:
Earlier you read the document below and made these notes on it:

<notes>
PulseWorks Fitness membership terms (UK, 2026). Three plans: Flex Saver at £29.99 a month with a 12-month minimum term and a price fixed for that term; Rolling at £39.99 a month with no minimum term, cancellable with one calendar month's notice; and Off-Peak at £24.99 (weekdays before 16:00 and after 20:00, plus weekends). There is a £20 joining fee unless a promotion waives it. Flex Saver members may cancel during the minimum term by giving one month's notice, and the plan rolls on after the 12 months. Members can freeze for up to two months a year at £5 a month, or up to six months free with a doctor's certificate; freezes extend a Flex Saver term. Rolling and Off-Peak prices can rise once a year with 30 days' email notice. Members may bring a guest up to six times a year; guests must be 18+, show photo ID and complete a health questionnaire, the host must stay in the club, and guests are responsible for any damage they cause. 16- and 17-year-olds need an induction and can't use free weights unsupervised. Only PulseWorks-registered trainers may coach. Failed direct debits are retried once; a second failure means a £10 fee and suspended access. Lockers must be emptied daily; replacement keys are £15.
</notes>

Here is the document itself, for reference:

<document>
PULSEWORKS FITNESS — MEMBERSHIP TERMS AND CONDITIONS (UK clubs, from 1 January 2026)

1. Membership plans. (a) Flex Saver: £29.99 per month, with a minimum term of 12 months from the start date. The monthly price is fixed for the minimum term. (b) Rolling: £39.99 per month, with no minimum term. Rolling members may cancel at any time by giving one full calendar month's notice through the app or at reception. (c) Off-Peak: £24.99 per month, rolling, with access before 16:00 and after 20:00 on weekdays and all day at weekends. A one-off joining fee of £20 applies to all plans unless waived under a promotion.

2. Cancelling during the minimum term. Flex Saver members may cancel before the end of the 12-month minimum term only if (i) they move to a permanent address more than 15 miles from any PulseWorks club, providing proof of address, or (ii) they have a medical condition that prevents them from exercising for the remainder of the term, confirmed by a doctor's certificate. In either case one month's notice is required. In all other cases, the remaining monthly payments for the minimum term remain payable. After the minimum term, Flex Saver membership continues on a rolling basis and may be cancelled with one month's notice.

3. Freezing membership. Members may freeze their membership for up to two months in any 12-month period for any reason, at a cost of £5 per month. Members with a doctor's certificate may freeze for up to six months free of charge. A frozen Flex Saver minimum term is extended by the length of the freeze.

4. Price changes. PulseWorks may change the monthly price of Rolling and Off-Peak memberships once in any 12-month period, giving at least 30 days' notice by email.

5. Guests. Members may bring a guest up to four times in any 12-month period. Guests must be aged 18 or over, must show photo ID and must complete a health questionnaire at reception. The host member must remain in the club with the guest and is responsible for the guest's conduct and for any damage the guest causes to equipment or facilities.

6. Under-18s. Members aged 16 and 17 may use the gym floor only after completing an induction, and may not use the free-weights area unsupervised.

7. Personal training. Only PulseWorks-registered personal trainers may train members in the club. External trainers are not permitted to coach, even if the trainer is also a member.

8. Payments. Monthly fees are collected by direct debit on or around the 1st of each month. If a payment fails, PulseWorks will retry once after seven days; if the second attempt fails, a £10 administration fee is charged and access is suspended until all arrears are paid.

9. Lockers and belongings. Day lockers must be emptied by closing time; items left overnight will be removed and held for 14 days. PulseWorks is not liable for loss of items from lockers except where caused by its own negligence. Replacement wristband keys cost £15.

10. Club closures. Clubs close on 25 December and may close for up to five further days per year for maintenance with 14 days' notice; no refunds are given for these closures.

11. Conduct. Membership may be terminated immediately, without refund, for violent, abusive or unsafe behaviour.
</document>

A few questions from someone who needs to act on this:
1. I'm four months into a Flex Saver membership, still live locally and am healthy, but I've lost interest. Can I cancel and stop paying after one more month?
2. I've already brought my sister as a guest four times this year. Can I bring her a fifth time?
3. My guest accidentally broke a cable machine attachment. Who is responsible for the damage?
4. How much does the Rolling plan cost per month?
response:
Checking against the full terms, my earlier notes were wrong on three points, and those errors affect your first three questions.

**1. Cancelling Flex Saver at month four: No, not without owing the rest of the term.**
Under clause 2, you can only cancel early if:
- you move permanently more than 15 miles from any PulseWorks club (with proof of address), or
- a medical condition stops you exercising for the rest of the term (with a doctor's certificate).

Since neither applies, "the remaining monthly payments for the minimum term remain payable." That's about 8 more payments of £29.99 (roughly £240). After the 12 months, you can cancel with one month's notice.
*My notes wrongly said Flex Saver members could cancel anytime with one month's notice.*

You could freeze for up to two months at £5 a month (clause 3). However, a freeze extends your minimum term by the same length, so it delays the payments rather than removing them.

**2. A fifth guest visit: No.**
Clause 5 allows a guest up to **four** times in any 12-month period, and you've used all four. The limit is per member, not per guest, so any other guest would also count against it.
*My notes wrongly said six.*

Note that the limit is a rolling 12 months, not a calendar year. Your allowance comes back as each visit passes the 12-month mark, which may be sooner than 1 January.

**3. Damage caused by your guest: You are responsible.**
Clause 5 says the host member "is responsible for the guest's conduct and for any damage the guest causes to equipment or facilities." It doesn't matter that it was an accident.
*My notes wrongly said the guest was responsible.*

**4. Rolling plan price: £39.99 per month.**
There's no minimum term and you can cancel with one full calendar month's notice. The price can rise once in any 12 months with at least 30 days' email notice. If you're joining new, there's also a £20 joining fee unless a promotion waives it.
